description: Triage an idea of the inbox: change its status (accept, reject, mark implemented), its priority, or link it to the matrix element it serves. Find the idea_id with search_ideas.

linked_element_id.description: UUID of the matrix element this idea serves. Pass an empty string to unlink.

links.description: Links to third-party tools (an A3, a QRQC, a ticket, a document, a project number). Sending the list REPLACES the current one: read it first (get_matrix_data, search_ideas) and send it back with your additions; [] clears it.

ref.description: Free reference: a URL, a ticket or project number, a path

name: update_idea
